title: Refactor Code Result
description: Return of the refactor-code agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject, how the fix goes about it and the files it changed, which pb checkpoint --step refactor commits as one fix group once the task's tests pass

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question a human should settle, or an issue the agent could not fix without changing behaviour, or an edit that was refused or failed, or an empty string. pb gate eval shows every non-empty one to the human as a doubt

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

approach.description: One short sentence naming how the fix goes about it, so a retry can be told which approaches were rejected, or empty string when nothing changed

no_change_reason.description: Why nothing needed changing (for example, an earlier fix group already resolved the finding), or an empty string when files changed. It lets pb checkpoint accept a fix that changed nothing without asking the human

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified
